worker-js-syntax.test: for f in src/index.js src/cards.js; do echo "=== Checking $f ===" && node -c "$f" && echo "PASS: $f" || echo "FAIL: $f"; done

scripts-syntax.test: for f in scripts/setup-251.sh scripts/setup-252.sh scripts/migrate-db.sh; do echo "=== Checking $f ===" && bash -n "$f" && echo "PASS: $f" || echo "FAIL: $f"; done

nginx-config-test.test: for f in nginx/cuneim.com.conf nginx/admin.cuneim.com.conf nginx/api.cuneim.com.conf nginx/stream.cuneim.com.conf; do echo "=== Checking $f ===" && nginx -t -c "$(pwd)/$f" 2>&1 || echo "NOTE: nginx may not be installed on this machine"; done

docker-compose-config.test: for f in docker-compose.251.yml docker-compose.252.yml; do echo "=== Checking $f ===" && docker compose -f "$f" config --quiet 2>&1 && echo "PASS: $f" || echo "NOTE: docker may not be installed on this machine"; done
